title: Wreckfest
tagline: Banger racing at its finest — five championships, a garage full of wrecks, and one very patient lawn mower.
order_note: Career first, in championship order — the rank, vehicle, and wrecking totals build up as you go, and the rank-50 grind is the cleanup after the campaign (expect to finish the story around rank 30–35). Multiplayer wins need human opponents; wins against AI don't count.
scope_note: Full game: all 20 achievements / 1,000G — the Windows (PC Game Pass) version. No TrueAchievements walkthrough exists; route notes are paraphrased from the Knoef and Fuzionbyte trophy guides, which cover the same achievements. About 15–20 hours.

achievements.name: Storm Warning
achievements.how: Win your first career race — it pops during the Regional Juniors championship.

achievements.name: Regional Juniors Champion
achievements.how: Complete the Regional Juniors championship, the first of the five career championships.

achievements.name: National Amateurs Champion
achievements.how: Complete the National Amateurs championship.

achievements.name: Challengers Champion
achievements.how: Complete the Challengers championship.

achievements.name: Pro Internationals Champion
achievements.how: Complete the Pro Internationals championship.

achievements.name: World Masters Champion
achievements.how: Complete the World Masters championship, the last of the five.

achievements.name: Highballer
achievements.how: Complete all career challenges — the special challenge events also unlock the special vehicles (Lawn Mower from Eat Dirt!, School Bus from the Oval Challenge, and more).

achievements.name: Dirty Roller
achievements.how: Reach player rank 10.

achievements.name: Trashing Around
achievements.how: Reach player rank 25.

achievements.name: Showing Some Dedication
achievements.how: Reach player rank 50 — 1,530,000 XP total. After the campaign you'll be around rank 30–35; grind the rest in a custom event (Motor City circuit, strong car, AI in lawnmowers, 60 laps, realistic damage, hard/expert) or a private deathmatch (Fairfield County Demolition Arena, friend + 6 AI, ~10,000 XP per 4 minutes).

achievements.name: Wheeler Dealer
achievements.how: Collect 10 vehicles — buy from the Market and collect the career-reward vehicles.

achievements.name: Junk Collector
achievements.how: Collect 20 vehicles.

achievements.name: Cash For Crashes
achievements.how: Earn 50,000 credits across career, multiplayer, and custom events.

achievements.name: Hating Them Tin Cans
achievements.how: Wreck 100 opponents — only the final hit counts, so an assist on a 90%-damaged car doesn't. A big tough vehicle against AI lawnmowers in a custom deathmatch is the fastest farm.

achievements.name: Glutton For Punishment
achievements.how: Get wrecked 100 times — it builds up through the campaign and multiplayer; if you're short, grab a lawnmower and get yourself killed.

achievements.name: Maniac Driver
achievements.how: Wreck 50 opponents with the School Bus — it unlocks from the Oval Challenge; some campaign missions use it, and the rest can be farmed in private matches against bots.

achievements.name: Look Mom, I Can Fly
achievements.how: Spend 5 minutes total in the air — Bone Breaker Valley has two good air spots per lap.

achievements.name: Garden Variety
achievements.how: Drive 1 hour with the Lawn Mower — it unlocks from the Eat Dirt! challenge. Custom event, no AI opponents, nudge it forward, then idle for an hour (keep the controller awake).

achievements.name: Rocketeer
achievements.how: Reach 210 km/h (130 mph) with the Rocket, the starter car — find a long straight or downhill stretch.

achievements.name: Human Lover
achievements.how: Win 20 multiplayer events — boostable in a private lobby with a friend, taking turns winning. Wins against AI opponents do not count.
